reason: Twelve dollars is nothing to me, but my whole system is stars and flags in my inbox plus a spreadsheet I invoice from, and it mostly works. Moving my clients, notes and tasks over is a weekend I don't have, so I'd probably bookmark it and never start the trial.
objection: Setting it up properly would eat a weekend, and if I only half move in I've just added a fifth app to check instead of replacing four.
would_change_my_mind: If it could pull in my existing inbox and calendar and build the client view for me in under an hour, so the dropped follow-ups show up without me re-entering anything.
